entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-07-10
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Consider setting DOTNET_HOST_PATH only for SDKs that are resolved to be >= 10.0 #49735
  • dotnet test for MTP: Verify and add test for console app that does "nothing" #49733
  • apphost file naming may collide with resource directory on Unix systems #49731
  • [Infrastructure] GH action for updating baselines on existing PRs #49729
  • Typo in browser connection message #49727
  • Replace obsolete WorkspaceFailed with RegisterWorkspaceFailedHandler in dotnet-watch IncrementalMSBuildWorkspace.cs #49725

Closed

  • GenerateWatchList doesn't collect all compile items #49542
  • dotnet watch fails with large solutions due to locked files. #49115
  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `sdk/release/9.0.1xx` can't be merged to Azdo internal branch #49422
  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `sdk/release/8.0.1xx` can't be merged to Azdo internal branch #49540
  • TargetExt conflicts with UseAppHost #3295
    Backlog
  • Ingest changes from NuGet that allow for modal dialogs to be launched #46423
  • Empty `#:project` appears to add a project item for the app directory #49670
    10.0.1xx
  • [NETSDKE2E][Loc][Regression] Workload information in .NET 10 Preview 4 is not localized #48451

PullRequests

Created

  • make containers net472 target resilient to incorrectly-determined DOTNET_HOST_PATH values #49736
    Area-SdkResolvers, Area-Containers, 10.0.1xx
  • Cleanup dotnet test #49734
    Area-dotnet test
  • Add warning for apphost file naming collision with culture directories (NETSDK1229) #49732
  • Add GitHub Actions workflow for updating static web assets baselines #49730
  • Use BuildManager.Build API and a custom msbuild logger to store props #49728
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/8.0.4xx' => 'release/9.0.1xx' #49724

Merged

  • .NET Source-Build 9.0.108 July 2025 Updates #49698
  • Use ProjectGraph for DTB #49589
    Area-Watch
  • Add Returns clauses to two key tool-packaging Targets to enable advanced users to build new kids of tool-based packages #49692
    Area-Tools
  • Update test method to fix test issue:47861 #49604
    Area-Infrastructure, Test Debt
  • Fail when `#:project` doesn't have any argument #49711
    Area-run-file
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/8.0.3xx' => 'release/8.0.4xx' #49695
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/8.0.1xx' => 'release/8.0.3xx' #49708
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #49706
    Area-CodeFlow
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/8.0.4xx' => 'release/9.0.1xx' #49694
  • Update branding to 9.0.109 #49653
    needs team triage, Area-Containers

Updated

  • Add flag and tests for codesigning single-file bundles targeting MacOS #49697
  • Implement `#:package` manipulation for file-based apps #49635
    Area-run-file
  • Automatically cleanup old artifacts of file-based apps #49666
    Area-run-file
  • Make `dotnet project convert` interactive #49660
    Area-run-file
  • Eliminate windowsdesktop, wpf, and winforms version elements #49722
  • Remove interactive special case for logger verbosity in `dotnet run` #47389
    untriaged, Area-CLI
  • Add support for CsWinRT 3.0 multi-targeting via Windows SDK build number #49721
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Add 'RunCsWinRTGenerator' task and target #49417
  • Make it so the artifacts folders register files for cleanup #49595
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/9.0.3xx' => 'main' #49389
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/9.0.1xx' => 'release/9.0.3xx' #49715
  • Add the property controlling publishing the symbols of reference projects #49707
